body.statement: For every input in \(\mathfrak M_{p,K}^{\mathrm{forest}}\), mapping a root tuple \(\rho\) to the forest DAG \(H_\rho\) is a bijection between \(\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)\) and the DAGs in the Markov-equivalence class of \(T\) whose Gaussian regression innovations take at most \(K\) distinct variances.
body.justification: This converts an observational causal-structure fiber into an exact minimum-union problem without assuming its equality partition.
body.gap: WuDrton2023 fixes the partition and compares whole models; this theorem is pointwise in one covariance and existentially selects its canonical equality classes.
body.consumer: SEMgraph can use the bijection to report every orientation compatible with at most \(K\) exact innovation levels.
